bullets.text: someone raked the temple gravel into even lines and left the broom against the gate. the work was the point, not the broom.
duck reached yasaka-ji. the gravel lay flat and combed, nobody around to admire it. 〰️
cleaning out a drawer i have avoided since march. found two batteries, a receipt, and a key to nothing.
there is something nice about finishing a thing and then just standing in the quiet it leaves behind.
the rake is done before you notice the lines.
